serviceName: Helm site and email (on a subdomain)
description: Points a subdomain (the applied host, e.g. shop.example.com) at the Helm-hosted site with a CNAME to the target Helm assigned it, and, in the email group, lets the site send mail from that subdomain: the signing key at resend._domainkey, the bounce return path at send (MX + SPF), and a monitor-only DMARC policy applied only when the name has none. Requires host: the apex form of this template is helm.biz.site.
variableDescription: %cname%: the hosting CNAME target Helm assigned this site (Vercel recommends a per-project target, e.g. abc123.vercel-dns-016.com); %dkim%: the base64 public half of the per-domain DKIM key the mail provider minted (without the leading p=); %region%: the mail provider's sending region, e.g. us-east-1
